issue.title: Record the decision that a bare public link is reading intent routed through ref jobs

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Add an accepted decisions record (new strand under decisions/, plus its roster line in decisions.md) for epic bob-cli-52 (plan:202610/url_capture_ref_routing.md, design decisions 1-4 and 12):

- Claim: a bare public link is reading intent. A capture item whose whole text is one eligible public http(s) URL becomes a reading-queue reference through a durable background ref job (`bob ref jobs`). A failed clip falls back to exactly the inbox task capture would have written, plus a ⚠️ child with the reason and a `bob ref create` retry command. Capture never blocks on the network. `bob gkeep pull` clips URL-only Keep notes inline, before the vault lock, and archives a note only after a terminal outcome. Anything more than a bare link (prose, @route, #tag, operators, forced flags, @@) stays a task. Corporate short links, IP literals, and exclude_hosts stay tasks. -R/--no-ref and the highlights.url_routing toggles opt out.
- Rejected alternatives: inline synchronous clipping (the Mac's 20 s timeout and lane cancellation would kill it, and offline capture would fail); a longer app timeout (it moves orchestration into Swift); a vault sweeper (a second writer with unbounded latency).
- Evidence: commits 2eafe60, 3232214, df9d504, 98fd8ae, f4fb812, 0a8c879 and c9b361b; the research report research:202610/url_capture_ref_intake_routing; and Bryan's approval of the plan.
- It complements `mac-capture-is-a-thin-client`: the Mac app only presents the `ref` object.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-52's plan asked its verify phase to propose this decisions record (bob-cli-52.9 note #2); the decisions roster has no record governing URL routing for capture, Bob Mac Capture, and Keep pull.

payload.entry: Context from bob-cli-5y.land: epic bob-cli-5y (plan:202610/ref_tasks_live_with_parent.md, J11 + design call 5; commits e6aa7a4, 091eda9) changed two claims in this proposed record. (1) A bare URL plus exactly one @route token, a bare URL under @route, or a bare URL with -r ROUTE now becomes a ref filed under that route (aliases allowed; an unresolvable route is an error with resolver hints) instead of staying a task. (2) A failed clip's fallback task now lands in the ref's parent note, and the retry command carries -P <parent>. Write the record against the current contract (docs/capture.md, docs/ref-jobs.md).
